'''Txomin Peillen Karrikaburu''' (17 November 1932 – 9 December 2022) was a French writer, linguist, and biologist.<ref>{{cite news |last=Lartzanguren-Iñigo|first=Astiz|date=10 December 2022|title=Txomin Peillen idazle eta euskaltzaina hil da, 90 urte zituela|trans-title= |url=https://www.berria.eus/albisteak/221821/txomin-peillen-idazle-eta-euskaltzaina-hil-da-90-urte-zituela.htm|language=Basque|work=[[Berria]]|location= |access-date=12 December 2022}}</ref>

==Biography==
Born into a family originally from [[Soule]] ([[Basque Country (greater region)|Basque Country]]), Peillen was born in [[Montmartre]] in the [[18th arrondissement of Paris]] to Joannes and Maddalen. While attending secondary school in [[Paris]], he taught [[Basque language|Basque]] at the {{ill|Lycée Lavoisier|fr}}. He earned a doctorate in Basque studies alongside {{ill|Jean Haritschelhar|fr}} and was a professor of Basque philology in [[Bayonne]].

Peillen was a fierce activist of Basque culture as a member of the [[Euskaltzaindia]] and the [[Basque Studies Society]], for which he earned the {{ill|Manuel Lekuona Award|eu|Manuel Lekuona Saria}} in 2009.<ref>{{cite news |last=Planes|first=Emmanuel|date=26 May 2010|title=Txomin Peillen, Basque et polyglotte|trans-title= |url=http://www.sudouest.fr/2010/05/26/txomin-peillen-basque-et-polyglotte-101693-4018.php|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20190830202242/https://www.sudouest.fr/2010/05/26/txomin-peillen-basque-et-polyglotte-101693-4018.php|archivedate=30 August 2019|language=French|work=[[Sud Ouest (newspaper)|Sud Ouest]]|location= |access-date=12 December 2022}}</ref> In total, he wrote 43 books, 39 of which were in Basque, three in French, and one in Spanish. Throughout his life, he lived in Bayonne and [[Sainte-Engrâce]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.samb-baiona.net/fr/publi/docs/BMB_index_decembre2011.html|title=Base de données chronologique des articles et auteurs du Bulletin du Musée Basque de 1924 à 2011|work=Les Amis du Musée Basque|language=French}}</ref>

Peillen died in [[Cambo-les-Bains]] on 9 December 2022, at the age of 90.<ref>{{cite news |last=Bedaxagar|first=Marcel|date=11 December 2022|title=Soule : homme de sciences et de langues, Txomin Peillen est décédé à l'âge de 90 ans|trans-title= |url=https://www.sudouest.fr/pyrenees-atlantiques/bayonne/pays-basque-homme-de-sciences-et-de-langues-txomin-peillen-est-decede-a-l-age-de-90-ans-13340640.php|language=French|work=Sud Ouest|location= |access-date=12 December 2022}}</ref>
